text:
serena: Heads up — VendorX removed their FlashAttention fork from the cuda-1.14 vendor build. Our fused-attn path is falling back to the xFormers kernels in prod canaries and we're seeing 15-30% RPS regressions for seq_len=2048. :grimacing:

dave: Can you paste the raw numbers + profile snapshot?

serena: Repro + profile from canary run:
```
model: llm-6b
seq: 2048
config: batch_strategy=auto, kv_cache=paged

kernel=fused-attn (falls back to xformers) -> avg token latency 12.2 ms, GPU util 45%, tokens/sec 85k
kernel=flash-v2 (native) -> avg token latency 9.8 ms, GPU util 63%, tokens/sec 110k
regression: ~+28% latency vs last successful rollout (fused compiled binary present)
```

kai: Ouch. Does the vendor change remove a binary we rely on, or did they change symbol names?

serena: Looks like they removed the prebuilt fused kernel blob and our runtime falls back to xFormers fallback implementation. Commit: https://github.com/vendorX/flash-fork/commit/abc123 (vendor downstream).

maria: Also flag: vLLM 0.7.2 included a KV-cache invalidation tweak that interacts poorly with paged-attn; when the kernel is slower the KV churn increases and we see eviction storms. Related PR: https://github.com/vllm/vllm/pull/672

serena: Combined effect is worse than each alone. Reproduced with perf harness locally. Short-term mitigation proposal:
```
# runtime config (example)
runtime.kernel_selection = ["flash_v2","paged","fused"]
runtime.fallback_policy = "no-fused"  # block the slow xformers fused fallback for now
perf.tuning.seq_threshold = 1024
```

kai: For canary we should force prefer flash_v2 for seq>1024 and disable fused fallback. Command to apply to canary cluster:
`rdctl config set --cluster=us-west-2-canary-3 runtime.kernel_selection=flash_v2,paged`

kai: Also tweak batching heuristic: cap batch_size=8 for seq>1024 to keep token tail latency bounded.

maria: And reduce KV eviction churn: set kv_cache.max_shards=16 and increase kv_cache.retention_ms to 120000 for canaries.

infra-bot: deploy:start - rolling update queued for us-west-2-canary-3 by @kai. (tracking id: deploy-1792345678-canary-1)

dave: I'll watch the per-route latency dashboards and topk traces. If no improvement in 30m we revert.

serena: Opening a follow-up ticket and upstream tracking doc to track: VendorX commit, FlashAttention upstream, vLLM PR, xFormers patches. Will include perf CI regression tests for seq=2048. :memo:

maria: We should add an integration check in perf-ci: compile matrix that simulates missing vendor blob (force xformers fallback) and assert tokens/sec >= baseline-10%.

serena: Agreed — adding to perf-ci and a short-term canary checklist.

dave: Thanks — ping me when dashboards show improvement. :thumbsup:
